From diris.lambdabar Require Export langtools.

Inductive expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Fun : string -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Unit : expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | Fork : expr -> expr
with val :=
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UnitV : val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
  | BarrierV : nat -> val.

Inductive linearity := Lin | Unr.

CoInductive type :=
  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
  | UnitT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type.

CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

Definition env_split (Γ : env) (Γ1 : env) (Γ2 : env) :=
  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.

Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=
  Γ' = <[ x := t ]> Γ ∧ ∀ t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t'.

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | Var_typed Γ x t :
    env_var Γ x t ->
    typed Γ (Var x) t
  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    typed Γ' e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | App_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    env_unr Γ ->
    typed Γ Unit UnitT
  | Pair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
    typed Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | Sum_typed Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
    typed Γ e (ts i) ->
    typed Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumN_typed n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
    typed Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
    typed Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | Fork_typed Γ e t1 t2 :
    typed Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (Fork e) (FunT Lin t1 t2).

Definition subst (x:string) (a:val) := fix rec e :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => e
  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | Fun x' e => Fun x' (if decide (x = x') then e else rec e)
  | App e1 e2 => App (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Unit => Unit
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | LetPair e1 e2 => LetPair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Sum n e => Sum n (rec e)
  | MatchSum n e1 e2 => MatchSum n (rec e1) (rec ∘ e2)
  | Fork e => Fork (rec e)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Fun_step x e :
    pure_step (Fun x e) (Val $ FunV x e)
  | App_step x e a :
    pure_step (App (Val $ FunV x e) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Unit_step :
    pure_step Unit (Val $ UnitV)
  | Pair_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val $ PairV v1 v2)
  | LetPair_step v1 v2 e:
    pure_step (LetPair (Val $ PairV v1 v2) e) (App (App e (Val v1)) (Val v2))
  | Sum_step n v :
    pure_step (Sum n (Val v)) (Val $ SumV n v)
  | MatchSum_step n (i : fin n) v es :
    pure_step (MatchSum n (Val $ SumV i v) es) (App (es i) (Val v)).

Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_App_l v : ctx1 (λ x, App x (Val v))
  | Ctx_App_r e : ctx1 (λ x, App e x)
  | Ctx_Pair_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair x e)
  | Ctx_Pair_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair e x)
  | Ctx_LetPair e : ctx1 (λ x, LetPair x e)
  | Ctx_Sum i : ctx1 (λ x, Sum i x)
  | Ctx_MatchSum n es : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSum n x es)
  | Ctx_Fork : ctx1 (λ x, Fork x).

Inductive ctx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_id : ctx id
  | Ctx_comp k1 k2 : ctx1 k1 -> ctx k2 -> ctx (k1 ∘ k2).

Inductive obj := Thread (e : expr) | Barrier.

Definition cfg := gmap nat obj.

Inductive local_step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
  | Pure_step i k e e' :
    ctx k -> pure_step e e' ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k e) ]} {[ i := Thread (k e') ]}
  | Exit_step i v :
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (Val v) ]} ∅
  | Fork_step i j n k v :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (Fork (Val v))) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ BarrierV n));
                    j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val $ BarrierV n));
                    n := Barrier ]}
  | Sync_step i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k1 -> ctx k2 ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k1 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v1)));
                    j := Thread (k2 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v2)));
                    n := Barrier ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k1 $ Val v2);
                    j := Thread (k2 $ Val v1) ]}.

Inductive step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
  | Frame_step ρ ρ' ρf i :
    ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ' ##ₘ ρf ->
    local_step i ρ ρ' -> step i (ρ ∪ ρf) (ρ' ∪ ρf).

Definition step' ρ ρ' := ∃ i, step i ρ ρ'.

Definition steps := rtc step'.

1	From diris.lambdabar Require Export langdef.

3	Fixpoint expr_refs e :=
4	  match e with
5	  | Val v => val_refs v
6	  | Var x => ∅
7	  | Fun x e => expr_refs e
8	  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
9	  | Unit => ∅
10	  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
11	  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
12	  | Sum i e => expr_refs e
13	  | MatchSum n e es => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es)
14	  | Fork e => expr_refs e
15	  end
16	with val_refs v :=
17	  match v with
18	  | FunV x e => expr_refs e
19	  | UnitV => ∅
20	  | PairV v1 v2 => val_refs v1 ∪ val_refs v2
21	  | SumV i v => val_refs v
22	  | BarrierV i => {[ i ]}
23	  end.
24	
25	Definition expr_waiting e j := ∃ k v, ctx k ∧ e = k (App (Val $ BarrierV j) (Val v)).
26	
27	Definition waiting (ρ : cfg) (i j : nat) :=
28	  match ρ !! i, ρ !! j with
29	  | Some (Thread e), Some Barrier => expr_waiting e j
30	  | Some Barrier, Some (Thread e) => i ∈ expr_refs e ∧ ¬ expr_waiting e i
31	  | _,_ => False
32	  end.
33	
34	Definition can_step (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ∃ ρ', step i ρ ρ'.
35	
36	Definition inactive (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ρ !! i = None.
37

From diris.lambdabar Require Export langdef.

Fixpoint expr_refs e :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_refs v
  | Var x => ∅
  | Fun x e => expr_refs e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Unit => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Sum i e => expr_refs e
  | MatchSum n e es => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es)
  | Fork e => expr_refs e
  end
with val_refs v :=
  match v with
  | FunV x e => expr_refs e
  | UnitV => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_refs v1 ∪ val_refs v2
  | SumV i v => val_refs v
  | BarrierV i => {[ i ]}
  end.

Definition expr_waiting e j := ∃ k v, ctx k ∧ e = k (App (Val $ BarrierV j) (Val v)).

Definition waiting (ρ : cfg) (i j : nat) :=
  match ρ !! i, ρ !! j with
  | Some (Thread e), Some Barrier => expr_waiting e j
  | Some Barrier, Some (Thread e) => i ∈ expr_refs e ∧ ¬ expr_waiting e i
  | _,_ => False
  end.

Definition can_step (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ∃ ρ', step i ρ ρ'.

Definition inactive (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ρ !! i = None.

Record deadlock (ρ : cfg) (s : nat -> Prop) := {
  dl_nostep i : s i -> ¬ can_step ρ i;
  dl_waiting i j : waiting ρ i j -> s i -> s j;
}.

Definition deadlock_free (ρ : cfg) :=
  ∀ s, deadlock ρ s -> ∀ i, s i -> inactive ρ i.

Inductive reachable (ρ : cfg) : nat -> Prop :=
  | Can_step_reachable i :
      can_step ρ i -> reachable ρ i
  | Waiting_reachable i j :
      waiting ρ i j -> reachable ρ j -> reachable ρ i.

Definition fully_reachable (ρ : cfg) :=
  ∀ i, inactive ρ i ∨ reachable ρ i.

Definition global_progress (ρ : cfg) :=
  (∀ i, inactive ρ i) ∨ (∃ i, can_step ρ i).

Definition type_safety (ρ : cfg) :=
  ∀ i, inactive ρ i ∨ can_step ρ i ∨ ∃ j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition fin_list {A} n (f : fin n -> A) : list A := vec_to_list (fun_to_vec f).

nat_pigeonhole:
  ∀ (f : nat → nat) (n1 n2 : nat),
    n2 < n1
    → (∀ i : nat, i < n1 → f i < n2)
      → ∃ i1 i2 : nat, i1 < i2 < n1 ∧ f i1 = f i2
Permutation_pigeonhole:
  ∀ [A : Type] [l1 l2 : list A],
    incl l1 l2
    → length l2 < length l1 → ∃ (a : A) (l3 : list A), l1 ≡ₚ a :: a :: l3
finite_pigeonhole:
  ∀ {A : Type} {EqDecision0 : EqDecision A} {H : Finite A} 
    {B : Type} {EqDecision1 : EqDecision B} {H0 : Finite B} 
    (f : A → B), card B < card A → ∃ x1 x2 : A, x1 ≠ x2 ∧ f x1 = f x2
Permutation_pigeonhole_rel:
  ∀ [A B : Type] (R : B → A → Prop) [l1 : list B] [l2 : list A],
    Forall (λ b : B, Exists (R b) l2) l1
    → length l2 < length l1
      → ∃ (b b' : B) (l3 : list B),
          l1 ≡ₚ b :: b' :: l3 ∧ ∃ a : A, In a l2 ∧ R b a ∧ R b' a
list_pigeonhole:
  ∀ {A : Type} (l1 l2 : list A),
    l1 ⊆ l2
    → length l2 < length l1
      → ∃ (i1 i2 : nat) (x : A),
          i1 < i2 ∧ l1 !! i1 = Some x ∧ l1 !! i2 = Some x
size_list_to_set:
  ∀ {A C : Type} {H : ElemOf A C} {H0 : Empty C} {H1 : Singleton A C} 
    {H2 : Union C} {H3 : Intersection C} {H4 : Difference C} 
    {H5 : Elements A C} {EqDecision0 : EqDecision A},
    FinSet A C → ∀ l : list A, NoDup l → size (list_to_set l) = length l
size_union_alt:
  ∀ {A C : Type} {H : ElemOf A C} {H0 : Empty C} {H1 : Singleton A C} 
    {H2 : Union C} {H3 : Intersection C} {H4 : Difference C} 
    {H5 : Elements A C} {EqDecision0 : EqDecision A},
    FinSet A C → ∀ X Y : C, size (X ∪ Y) = size X + size (Y ∖ X)
size_union:
  ∀ {A C : Type} {H : ElemOf A C} {H0 : Empty C} {H1 : Singleton A C} 
    {H2 : Union C} {H3 : Intersection C} {H4 : Difference C} 
    {H5 : Elements A C} {EqDecision0 : EqDecision A},
    FinSet A C → ∀ X Y : C, X ## Y → size (X ∪ Y) = size X + size Y
elements: ∀ {A C : Type}, Elements A C → C → list A
mapset.mapset_elements:
  ∀ {K : Type} {M : Type → Type},

elements_in_partition:
  ∀ [A : Type] (f : A → bool) (l : list A) [l1 l2 : list A],

From diris.lambdabar Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Program.Equality.
From stdpp Require Import base.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition dual (t : type) : type :=
  match t with
  | FunT Lin a b => FunT Lin b a
  | _ => t
  end.

Lemma dual_FunT a b : dual (FunT Lin a b) = FunT Lin b a.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual a b : dual (dual (FunT Lin a b)) = FunT Lin a b.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_inj p q : dual p = dual q -> p = q.
Proof.
  destruct p, q; simpl; intros H; try discriminate; inversion H; subst; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Extensional facts about [unr] (a coinductive predicate). *)
Lemma unr_FunT_inv l a b : unr (FunT l a b) -> l = Unr.
Proof. intros H. dependent destruction H. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma unr_PairT_inv a b : unr (PairT a b) -> unr a /\ unr b.
Proof. intros H. dependent destruction H. auto. Qed.

Lemma unr_SumT_inv n ts : unr (SumT n ts) -> forall i, unr (ts i).
Proof. intros H. dependent destruction H. auto. Qed.

Lemma unr_UnitT : unr UnitT.
Proof. constructor. Qed.

Lemma unr_FunT_Unr a b : unr (FunT Unr a b).
Proof. constructor. Qed.

Lemma unr_FunT_Lin_false a b : unr (FunT Lin a b) -> False.
Proof. intros H. dependent destruction H. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Runtime typing                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Inductive rt : env -> gmap nat type -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
| rt_Var Γ Δ x t :
    env_var Γ x t -> Δ = ∅ -> rt Γ Δ (Var x) t
| rt_Fun Γ Γ' Δ x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    (l = Unr -> Δ = ∅) ->
    rt Γ' Δ e t2 ->
    rt Γ Δ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
| rt_App Γ Γ1 Γ2 Δ Δ1 Δ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    Δ = Δ1 ∪ Δ2 -> Δ1 ##ₘ Δ2 ->
    rt Γ1 Δ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
    rt Γ2 Δ2 e2 t1 ->
    rt Γ Δ (App e1 e2) t2
| rt_Unit Γ Δ :
    env_unr Γ -> Δ = ∅ -> rt Γ Δ Unit UnitT
| rt_Pair Γ Γ1 Γ2 Δ Δ1 Δ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    Δ = Δ1 ∪ Δ2 -> Δ1 ##ₘ Δ2 ->
    rt Γ1 Δ1 e1 t1 -> rt Γ2 Δ2 e2 t2 ->
    rt Γ Δ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
| rt_LetPair Γ Γ1 Γ2 Δ Δ1 Δ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    Δ = Δ1 ∪ Δ2 -> Δ1 ##ₘ Δ2 ->
    rt Γ1 Δ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
    rt Γ2 Δ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
    rt Γ Δ (LetPair e1 e2) t
| rt_Sum Γ Δ n ts i e :
    rt Γ Δ e (ts i) -> rt Γ Δ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
| rt_MatchSum n Γ Γ1 Γ2 Δ Δ1 Δ2 t ts es e :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    Δ = Δ1 ∪ Δ2 -> Δ1 ##ₘ Δ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
    rt Γ1 Δ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
    (forall i, rt Γ2 Δ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
    rt Γ Δ (MatchSum n e es) t
| rt_Fork Γ Δ e t1 t2 :
    rt Γ Δ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
    rt Γ Δ (Fork e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
| rt_Val Γ Δ v t :
    rtv Γ Δ v t -> rt Γ Δ (Val v) t
with rtv : env -> gmap nat type -> val -> type -> Prop :=
| rtv_Unit Γ Δ :
    env_unr Γ -> Δ = ∅ -> rtv Γ Δ UnitV UnitT
| rtv_Fun Γ Γ' Δ x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    (l = Unr -> Δ = ∅) ->
    rt Γ' Δ e t2 ->
    rtv Γ Δ (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
| rtv_Pair Γ Γ1 Γ2 Δ Δ1 Δ2 v1 v2 t1 t2 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    Δ = Δ1 ∪ Δ2 -> Δ1 ##ₘ Δ2 ->
    rtv Γ1 Δ1 v1 t1 -> rtv Γ2 Δ2 v2 t2 ->
    rtv Γ Δ (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
| rtv_Sum Γ Δ n ts i v :
    rtv Γ Δ v (ts i) -> rtv Γ Δ (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
| rtv_Barrier Γ Δ n a b :
    env_unr Γ -> Δ = {[ n := FunT Lin a b ]} ->
    rtv Γ Δ (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin a b).
EOF

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic environment and endpoint-context lemmas                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma env_unr_subset Γ Γ' : env_unr Γ -> Γ ⊆ Γ' -> env_unr Γ'.
Proof.
  intros H Hsub x t Hx. apply H. exact ((map_subseteq_spec _ _).1 Hsub x t Hx).
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. intros x t Hx. rewrite lookup_empty in Hx. discriminate. Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert Γ x t : env_unr (<[x:=t]> Γ) -> env_unr Γ.
Proof.
  intros H. apply (env_unr_subset H). intros i v Hi.
  rewrite lookup_insert_ne; [done|]. intros ->. rewrite lookup_insert_eq in Hi. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_ty Γ x t : env_unr (<[x:=t]> Γ) -> unr t.
Proof.
  intros H. apply (H x t). rewrite lookup_insert_eq. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_union_l Γ1 Γ2 : env_unr (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) -> env_unr Γ1.
Proof.
  intros H x t Hx. apply H. rewrite lookup_union, Hx. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_union_r Γ1 Γ2 : env_unr (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) -> env_unr Γ2.
Proof.
  intros H x t Hx. apply H. rewrite lookup_union, Hx.
  destruct (Γ1 !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_union Γ1 Γ2 : env_unr Γ1 -> env_unr Γ2 -> env_unr (Γ1 ∪ Γ2).
Proof.
  intros H1 H2 x t Hx. rewrite lookup_union in Hx.
  destruct (Γ1 !! x) eqn:E1; destruct (Γ2 !! x) eqn:E2; simpl in Hx.
  - inversion Hx as [Ht]. subst. apply H1. done.
  - inversion Hx as [Ht]. subst. apply H1. done.
  - inversion Hx as [Ht]. subst. apply H2. done.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_comm Γ Γ1 Γ2 : env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> env_split Γ Γ2 Γ1.
Proof.
  intros [Heq [Hd]]. split.
  - rewrite Heq. apply map_union_comm. done.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. apply (Hd i t2 t1 H2 H1).
Qed.
EOF

Lemma delete_union_distr_str {A} (m1 m2 : gmap string A) x :
  delete x (m1 ∪ m2) = delete x m1 ∪ delete x m2.
Proof.
  apply map_eq. intro i. rewrite (lookup_delete (m1 ∪ m2) x i).
  destruct (decide (x = i)) as [Heq|Hne].
  - subst i.
    rewrite (lookup_union (delete x m1) (delete x m2) x).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_eq m1 x), (lookup_delete_eq m2 x). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (m1 ∪ m2) x i) by done.
    rewrite (lookup_union m1 m2 i), (lookup_union (delete x m1) (delete x m2) i).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_ne m1 x i) by done. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne m2 x i) by done.
    done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_ambient Γ Γ1 Γ2 x s :
  env_split (<[x:=s]>Γ) Γ1 Γ2 -> x ∉ dom Γ ->
  (Γ2 !! x = None /\ env_split Γ (delete x Γ1) Γ2) \/
  (Γ1 !! x = None /\ env_split Γ Γ1 (delete x Γ2)) \/
  (Γ1 !! x = Some s /\ Γ2 !! x = Some s /\ unr s /\
   env_split Γ (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2)).
Proof.
  intros [Heq Hd] Hx.
  destruct (Γ1 !! x) as [a|] eqn:E1; destruct (Γ2 !! x) as [b|] eqn:E2.
  - (* both Some *)
    assert (Ha : a = s).
    { have Hl : (<[x:=s]>Γ) !! x = Some s by (rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x s); done).
      rewrite Heq in Hl. rewrite (lookup_union_Some_l Γ1 Γ2 x a E1) in Hl.
      injection Hl as Hl. done. }
    subst a. destruct (Hd x s b E1 E2) as [Hb Hu]. subst b.
    right. right. split; [done|]. split; [done|]. split; [done|]. split.
    + rewrite <- (delete_insert_id Γ x s Hx). rewrite Heq.
      apply delete_union_distr_str.
    + apply disj_mono_l with Γ1; [| apply delete_subseteq].
      apply disj_mono_r with Γ2; [done| apply delete_subseteq].
  - (* Γ1 Some, Γ2 None *)
    left. split; [done|]. split.
    + rewrite <- (delete_insert_id Γ x s Hx). rewrite Heq.
      rewrite (insert_delete_id Γ1 x s E1).
      rewrite (delete_union_l_str (<[x:=s]>(delete x Γ1)) Γ2 x E2).
      rewrite (delete_insert_id (delete x Γ1) x s) by (rewrite lookup_delete_eq; done).
      done.
    + apply disj_mono_l with Γ1; [| apply delete_subseteq].
      apply disj_mono_r with Γ2; [done| apply delete_subseteq].
  - (* Γ1 None, Γ2 Some *)
    right. left. split; [done|]. split.
    + rewrite <- (delete_insert_id Γ x s Hx). rewrite Heq.
      rewrite (insert_delete_id Γ2 x s E2).
      rewrite (delete_union_r_str Γ1 (<[x:=s]>(delete x Γ2)) x E1).
      rewrite (delete_insert_id (delete x Γ2) x s) by (rewrite lookup_delete_eq; done).
      done.
    + apply disj_mono_l with Γ1; [| apply delete_subseteq].
      apply disj_mono_r with Γ2; [done| apply delete_subseteq].
  - (* both None: impossible *)
    exfalso.
    have Hl : (<[x:=s]>Γ) !! x = Some s by (rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x s); done).
    rewrite Heq in Hl.
    destruct (Γ1 !! x); destruct (Γ2 !! x); try discriminate; done.
Qed.
EOF

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic consequences of the configuration invariant                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma lookup_some_of_neq {A} (m : gmap nat A) n : m !! n <> None -> exists t, m !! n = Some t.
Proof.
  destruct (m !! n) as [t|] eqn:E; [eexists; done| intros H; exfalso; apply H; done].
Qed.

Lemma inv_holder_eq (I : inv ρ) n a b k :
  live ρ n -> a <> b ->
  I.(iD) a !! n <> None -> I.(iD) b !! n <> None -> I.(iD) k !! n <> None ->
  k = a \/ k = b.
Proof.
  intros Hl Hab Ha Hb Hk.
  destruct (lookup_some_of_neq (I.(iD) a) n Ha) as (ta & Ea).
  destruct (lookup_some_of_neq (I.(iD) b) n Hb) as (tb & Eb).
  destruct (lookup_some_of_neq (I.(iD) k) n Hk) as (tk & Ek).
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) n a ta Hl Ea) as [Aa|Aa]; subst a;
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) n b tb Hl Eb) as [Bb|Bb]; subst b;
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) n k tk Hl Ek) as [Kk|Kk]; subst k;
  try (left; done); try (right; done); exfalso; apply Hab; done.
Qed.

Lemma inv_pair_types (I : inv ρ) n p q a b :
  live ρ n -> I.(iOm) !! n = Some (p, q) -> a <> b ->
  I.(iD) a !! n <> None -> I.(iD) b !! n <> None ->
  (I.(iD) a !! n = Some p /\ I.(iD) b !! n = Some q) \/
  (I.(iD) a !! n = Some q /\ I.(iD) b !! n = Some p).
Proof.
  intros Hl Hom Hab Ha Hb.
  pose proof (I.(i_H_neq) n Hl) as Hneq.
  pose proof (I.(i_H1) n p q Hl Hom) as E1.
  pose proof (I.(i_H2) n p q Hl Hom) as E2.
  destruct (lookup_some_of_neq (I.(iD) a) n Ha) as (ta & Ea).
  destruct (lookup_some_of_neq (I.(iD) b) n Hb) as (tb & Eb).
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) n a ta Hl Ea) as [Aa|Aa]; subst a;
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) n b tb Hl Eb) as [Bb|Bb]; subst b.
  - exfalso. apply Hab. done.
  - left. split; [exact E1|exact E2].
  - right. split; [exact E2|exact E1].
  - exfalso. apply Hab. done.
Qed.

Lemma inv_holder_thread (I : inv ρ) n k :
  live ρ n -> I.(iD) k !! n <> None -> exists e, ρ !! k = Some (Thread e).
Proof.
  intros Hl Hk. destruct (ρ !! k) as [[e|]|] eqn:E.
  - exists e. done.
  - exfalso. assert (Hnd : forall e0, ρ !! k <> Some (Thread e0)) by (intros e0 Hc; rewrite E in Hc; discriminate).
    pose proof (I.(i_nonthr) k Hnd) as HD. rewrite HD in Hk. rewrite lookup_empty in Hk. apply Hk. done.
  - exfalso. assert (Hnd : forall e0, ρ !! k <> Some (Thread e0)) by (intros e0 Hc; rewrite E in Hc; discriminate).
    pose proof (I.(i_nonthr) k Hnd) as HD. rewrite HD in Hk. rewrite lookup_empty in Hk. apply Hk. done.
Qed.

Lemma inv_live_of_holder (I : inv ρ) n k :
  I.(iD) k !! n <> None -> live ρ n.
Proof.
  intros Hk. destruct (I.(i_live_iff) n) as [Hf _].
  destruct (I.(iOm) !! n) as [[p q]|] eqn:E.
  - apply Hf. rewrite E. discriminate.
  - exfalso. destruct (lookup_some_of_neq (I.(iD) k) n Hk) as (t & Ht).
    exact (I.(i_dead) n k t E Ht).
Qed.

Lemma inv_holder_partner (I : inv ρ) n i :
  live ρ n -> I.(iD) i !! n <> None ->
  exists j, j <> i /\ I.(iD) j !! n <> None.
Proof.
  intros Hl Hi.
  destruct (lookup_some_of_neq (I.(iD) i) n Hi) as (ti & Ei).
  destruct (I.(i_live_iff) n) as [Hf _].
  assert (Home : I.(iOm) !! n <> None) by (apply Hf; done).
  destruct (lookup_some_of_neq (I.(iOm) n) Home) as ((p & q) & Hom).
  pose proof (I.(i_H_neq) n Hl) as Hneq.
  pose proof (I.(i_H1) n p q Hl Hom) as E1.
  pose proof (I.(i_H2) n p q Hl Hom) as E2.
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) n i ti Hl Ei) as [Ai|Ai]; subst i.
  - exists (I.(i_H2) n). split; [done|]. rewrite E2. discriminate.
  - exists (I.(i_H1) n). split; [done|]. rewrite E1. discriminate.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Decomposing configurations around a small set of local keys        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma cfg_decomp1 (ρ : cfg) i (o : obj) : ρ !! i = Some o ->
  ρ = {[i := o]} ∪ delete i ρ.
Proof.
  intros H. apply map_eq. intro k.
  rewrite (lookup_union ({[i:=o]}) (delete i ρ) k).
  destruct (decide (i = k)) as [Heq|Hne].
  - subst k. rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (∅ : gmap nat obj) i o).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_eq ρ i). simpl. exact H.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (∅ : gmap nat obj) i k o Hne).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_ne ρ i k Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma cfg_disj1 (ρ : cfg) i (o : obj) : ({[i := o]} : cfg) ##ₘ delete i ρ.
Proof.
  rewrite map_disjoint_singleton_l. apply (lookup_delete_eq ρ i).
Qed.

Lemma cfg_decomp3 (ρ : cfg) i oi j oj n on :
  i <> j -> i <> n -> j <> n ->
  ρ !! i = Some oi -> ρ !! j = Some oj -> ρ !! n = Some on ->
  ρ = {[i := oi; j := oj; n := on]} ∪ delete i (delete j (delete n ρ)).
Proof.
  intros Hij Hin Hjn Hi Hj Hn.
  apply map_eq. intro k.
  rewrite (lookup_union ({[i := oi; j := oj; n := on]}) (delete i (delete j (delete n ρ))) k).
  destruct (decide (k = i)) as [->|Hki].
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (∅ : gmap nat obj) i oi).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_eq ρ i). rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (delete j (delete n ρ)) i). simpl. exact Hi.
  - destruct (decide (k = j)) as [->|Hkj].
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (∅ : gmap nat obj) i j oi Hki).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (∅ : gmap nat obj) j oj).
      rewrite (lookup_delete_ne ρ i j (fun Hc => Hki (eq_sym Hc))).
      rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (delete j (delete n ρ)) j). simpl. exact Hj.
    + destruct (decide (k = n)) as [->|Hkn].
      * rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (∅ : gmap nat obj) i n oi Hki).
        rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (∅ : gmap nat obj) j n oj Hkj).
        rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (∅ : gmap nat obj) n on).
        rewrite (lookup_delete_ne ρ i n (fun Hc => Hki (eq_sym Hc))).
        rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (delete n ρ) j n (fun Hc => Hkj (eq_sym Hc))).
        rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (delete n ρ) n).
        rewrite (lookup_delete_ne ρ n n) by done.
        simpl. exact Hn.
      * rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (∅ : gmap nat obj) i k oi Hki).
        rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (∅ : gmap nat obj) j k oj Hkj).
        rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (∅ : gmap nat obj) n k on Hkn).
        rewrite (lookup_delete_ne ρ i k (fun Hc => Hki (eq_sym Hc))).
        rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (delete j (delete n ρ)) i k (fun Hc => Hki (eq_sym Hc))).
        rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (delete n ρ) j k (fun Hc => Hkj (eq_sym Hc))).
        rewrite (lookup_delete_ne ρ j k (fun Hc => Hkj (eq_sym Hc))).
        rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (delete n ρ) n k (fun Hc => Hkn (eq_sym Hc))).
        rewrite (lookup_delete_ne ρ n k (fun Hc => Hkn (eq_sym Hc))).
        done.
Qed.

Lemma cfg_disj3 (ρ : cfg) i oi j oj n on :
  i <> j -> i <> n -> j <> n ->
  ({[i := oi; j := oj; n := on]} : cfg) ##ₘ delete i (delete j (delete n ρ)).
Proof.
  intros Hij Hin Hjn.
  rewrite map_disjoint_insert_l. split.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (delete j (delete n ρ)) i i) by done. done.
  - rewrite map_disjoint_insert_l. split.
    + rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (delete n ρ) j j) by done. rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (delete n ρ) j). done.
    + rewrite map_disjoint_insert_l. split.
      * rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (delete n ρ) n). done.
      * rewrite map_disjoint_empty_l. done.
Qed.
EOF

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Threads, closed sets, and deadlock freedom                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition is_thread (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) : Prop := exists e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e).

#[global] Instance is_thread_dec (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) : Decision (is_thread ρ i).
Proof.
  unfold is_thread. destruct (ρ !! i) as [[e|]|]; [left; eauto| right; intros [e H]; discriminate
  | right; intros [e H]; discriminate].
Defined.

Definition threads (ρ : cfg) : gset nat := filter (is_thread ρ) (dom ρ).

Lemma elem_of_threads (ρ : cfg) i : i ∈ threads ρ <-> is_thread ρ i.
Proof.
  unfold threads. rewrite elem_of_filter. split.
  - intros [HP _]. exact HP.
  - intros HP. split; [exact HP|]. apply elem_of_dom. destruct HP as (e & H). eexists. exact H.
Qed.

Definition wclosed (I : inv ρ) (S : gset nat) : Prop :=
  forall x, x ∈ S -> exists e j,
    ρ !! x = Some (Thread e) /\ expr_waiting e j /\
    I.(iD) x !! j <> None /\ live ρ j /\ I.(iH1) j ∈ S /\ I.(iH2) j ∈ S.

Lemma gset_size_strong_ind (P : gset nat -> Prop) :
  (forall S, (forall T, size T < size S -> P T) -> P S) -> forall S, P S.

  assert (forall n, forall S, size S <= n -> P S) as Ha.

    - apply H. intros T Hlt. assert (H0 : size S = 0) by lia. lia.
    - apply H. intros T Hlt. apply IH. lia. }
  apply (Ha (size S) S). lia.
Qed.

Lemma inv_local_pure {ρ0 ρ0' ρf : cfg} {i : nat}

  change (ρ0' = ({[i := Thread (k e')]} : cfg)) in *.

  ct_disj : Δk ##ₘ Δh;
  ct_fill : forall e, rt ∅ Δh e s -> rt ∅ (Δk ∪ Δh) (k e) t;
}.

  forall e Δ t, rt ∅ Δ (k e) t ->
  exists Δk Δh s, Δ = Δk ∪ Δh /\ ctx_typing k Δk Δh s t /\ rt ∅ Δh e s.
Proof.
  intros Hk. destruct Hk; intros ex Δ t H; simpl in H.
  - apply ctx1_decomp_apply_l in H. exact H.
  - apply ctx1_decomp_apply_r in H. exact H.
  - apply ctx1_decomp_pair_l in H. exact H.
  - apply ctx1_decomp_pair_r in H. exact H.
  - apply ctx1_decomp_letpair in H. exact H.
  - apply ctx1_decomp_sum in H. exact H.

Lemma ctx_decomp (k : expr -> expr) : ctx k ->
  forall e Δ t, rt ∅ Δ (k e) t ->
  exists Δk Δh s, Δ = Δk ∪ Δh /\ ctx_typing k Δk Δh s t /\ rt ∅ Δh e s.
Proof.
  intros Hk. induction Hk; intros e0 Δ0 t0 Hex.
  - exists (∅ : gmap nat type), Δ0, t0. split.
    + symmetry. apply union_empty_l_nat.
    + split.
      * split; [apply map_disjoint_empty_l|]. intros e' He'. rewrite union_empty_l_nat. exact He'.
      * exact Hex.
  - change (rt ∅ Δ0 (k1 (k2 e0)) t0) in Hex.
    destruct (ctx1_decomp (k := k1) H Hex)
      as (Δk1 & Δh1 & s1 & Heq1 & Hct1 & Hh1).
    destruct (IHHk e0 Δh1 s1 Hh1)
      as (Δk2 & Δh2 & s2 & Heq2 & Hct2 & Hh2).
    exists (Δk1 ∪ Δk2), Δh2, s2. split.
    + rewrite Heq1, Heq2. rewrite map_union_assoc. done.
    + split.
      * constructor.
        -- apply map_disjoint_union_l. split.
           ++ destruct (map_disjoint_union_r Δk1 Δk2 Δh2) as [Hf _].
              assert (Hd : Δk1 ##ₘ (Δk2 ∪ Δh2)) by (rewrite <- Heq2; exact (ct_disj Hct1)).
              destruct (Hf Hd) as [_ Hr]. exact Hr.
           ++ exact (ct_disj Hct2).
        -- intros e' He'. rewrite <- map_union_assoc. rewrite <- Heq2.
           apply (ct_fill Hct1). rewrite Heq2. apply (ct_fill Hct2). exact He'.
      * exact Hh2.
Qed.

2213:Lemma fork_decomp (D : gmap nat type) k v :
Lemma fork_decomp (D : gmap nat type) k v :
  ctx k -> rt ∅ D (k (Fork (Val v))) UnitT ->
  exists Δk Δh t1 t2, D = Δk ∪ Δh /\
    ctx_typing k Δk Δh (FunT Lin t1 t2) UnitT /\
    rtv Δh v (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT).
Proof.
  intros Hk Hrt.
  destruct (@ctx_decomp k Hk (Fork (Val v)) D UnitT Hrt) as (Δk & Δh & s & Heq & Hct & Hh).
  inversion Hh; subst; clear Hh.
  inversion H2; subst; clear H2.
  exists Δk, Δh, t1, t2. split; [done|]. split; [exact Hct|exact H4].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic consequences of the configuration invariant                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma lookup_some_of_neq {A} (m : gmap nat A) n : m !! n <> None -> exists t, m !! n = Some t.
Proof.
  destruct (m !! n) as [t|] eqn:E; [eexists; done| intros H; exfalso; apply H; done].
Qed.

Lemma inv_holder_eq {ρ : cfg} (ID : nat -> gmap nat type) (IOm : gmap nat (type * type)) (IS : nat -> nat -> bool) (IH1 IH2 : nat -> nat) (I : invP ρ ID IOm IS IH1 IH2) n a b k :
  live ρ n -> a <> b ->
  ID a !! n <> None -> ID b !! n <> None -> ID k !! n <> None ->
  k = a \/ k = b.
Proof.
  intros Hl Hab Ha Hb Hk.
  destruct (@lookup_some_of_neq type (ID a) n Ha) as (ta & Ea).
  destruct (@lookup_some_of_neq type (ID b) n Hb) as (tb & Eb).
  destruct (@lookup_some_of_neq type (ID k) n Hk) as (tk & Ek).
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) Hl Ea) as [Aa|Aa]; subst a;
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) Hl Eb) as [Bb|Bb]; subst b;
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) Hl Ek) as [Kk|Kk]; subst k;
  try (left; done); try (right; done); exfalso; apply Hab; done.
Qed.

Lemma inv_pair_types {ρ : cfg} (ID : nat -> gmap nat type) (IOm : gmap nat (type * type)) (IS : nat -> nat -> bool) (IH1 IH2 : nat -> nat) (I : invP ρ ID IOm IS IH1 IH2) n p q a b :
  live ρ n -> IOm !! n = Some (p, q) -> a <> b ->
  ID a !! n <> None -> ID b !! n <> None ->
  (ID a !! n = Some p /\ ID b !! n = Some q) \/
  (ID a !! n = Some q /\ ID b !! n = Some p).
Proof.
  intros Hl Hom Hab Ha Hb.
  pose proof (I.(i_H_neq) Hl) as Hneq.
  pose proof (I.(i_H1) Hl Hom) as E1.
  pose proof (I.(i_H2) Hl Hom) as E2.
  destruct (@lookup_some_of_neq type (ID a) n Ha) as (ta & Ea).
  destruct (@lookup_some_of_neq type (ID b) n Hb) as (tb & Eb).
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) Hl Ea) as [Aa|Aa]; subst a;
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) Hl Eb) as [Bb|Bb]; subst b.
  - exfalso. apply Hab. done.
  - left. split; [exact E1|exact E2].
  - right. split; [exact E2|exact E1].
  - exfalso. apply Hab. done.
Qed.

Lemma inv_holder_thread {ρ : cfg} (ID : nat -> gmap nat type) (IOm : gmap nat (type * type)) (IS : nat -> nat -> bool) (IH1 IH2 : nat -> nat) (I : invP ρ ID IOm IS IH1 IH2) n k :
  live ρ n -> ID k !! n <> None -> exists e, ρ !! k = Some (Thread e).
Proof.
  intros Hl Hk. destruct (ρ !! k) as [[e|]|] eqn:E.
  - exists e. done.
  - exfalso. assert (Hnd : forall e0, ρ !! k <> Some (Thread e0)) by (intros e0 Hc; rewrite E in Hc; discriminate).
    pose proof (I.(i_nonthr) Hnd) as HD. rewrite HD in Hk. rewrite lookup_empty in Hk. apply Hk. done.
  - exfalso. assert (Hnd : forall e0, ρ !! k <> Some (Thread e0)) by (intros e0 Hc; rewrite E in Hc; discriminate).
    pose proof (I.(i_nonthr) Hnd) as HD. rewrite HD in Hk. rewrite lookup_empty in Hk. apply Hk. done.
Qed.

Lemma inv_live_of_holder {ρ : cfg} (ID : nat -> gmap nat type) (IOm : gmap nat (type * type)) (IS : nat -> nat -> bool) (IH1 IH2 : nat -> nat) (I : invP ρ ID IOm IS IH1 IH2) n k :
  ID k !! n <> None -> live ρ n.
Proof.
  intros Hk.
  destruct (IOm !! n) as [[p q]|] eqn:E.
  - destruct (I.(i_live_iff) n) as [_ Hg]. apply Hg. rewrite E. discriminate.
  - exfalso. destruct (@lookup_some_of_neq type (ID k) n Hk) as (t & Ht).
    exact (I.(i_dead) E Ht).
Qed.

Lemma inv_holder_partner {ρ : cfg} (ID : nat -> gmap nat type) (IOm : gmap nat (type * type)) (IS : nat -> nat -> bool) (IH1 IH2 : nat -> nat) (I : invP ρ ID IOm IS IH1 IH2) n i :
  live ρ n -> ID i !! n <> None ->
  exists j, j <> i /\ ID j !! n <> None.
Proof.
  intros Hl Hi.
  destruct (@lookup_some_of_neq type (ID i) n Hi) as (ti & Ei).
  destruct (I.(i_live_iff) n) as [Hf _].
  assert (Home : IOm !! n <> None) by (apply Hf; done).
  destruct (@lookup_some_of_neq (type*type) (IOm) n Home) as ((p & q) & Hom).
  pose proof (I.(i_H_neq) Hl) as Hneq.
  pose proof (I.(i_H1) Hl Hom) as E1.
  pose proof (I.(i_H2) Hl Hom) as E2.
  destruct (I.(i_H_exact) Hl Ei) as [Ai|Ai]; subst i.
  - exists (IH2 n). split; [done|]. rewrite E2. discriminate.
  - exists (IH1 n). split; [done|]. rewrite E1. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma sync_decomp (D : gmap nat type) k n v :
  ctx k -> rt ∅ D (k (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v))) UnitT ->
  exists Δk Δn Δv a b, D = Δk ∪ (Δn ∪ Δv) /\ Δn ##ₘ Δv /\
    Δn = {[n := FunT Lin a b]} /\
    ctx_typing k Δk (Δn ∪ Δv) b UnitT /\
    rtv Δv v a.
Proof.
  intros Hk Hrt.
  destruct (@ctx_decomp k Hk (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v)) D UnitT Hrt)
    as (Δk & Δh & s & Heq & Hct & Hh).
  inversion Hh; subst; clear Hh.
  destruct (env_split_empty H1 eq_refl) as [E1 E2]. rewrite E1 in H6. rewrite E2 in H8.
  inversion H6; subst; clear H6.
  dependent destruction H5.
  inversion H8; subst; clear H8.
  exists Δk, {[n := FunT Lin t1 s]}, Δ2, t1, s.
  split; [done|]. split; [exact H3|]. split; [done|]. split; [exact Hct|exact H6].
Qed.

content.content:
with rtv : gmap nat type -> val -> type -> Prop :=
| rtv_Unit Δ :
    Δ = ∅ -> rtv Δ UnitV UnitT
| rtv_Fun Δ x e t1 t2 l :
    (l = Unr -> Δ = ∅) ->
    rt {[ x := t1 ]} Δ e t2 ->
    rtv Δ (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
| rtv_Pair Δ Δ1 Δ2 v1 v2 t1 t2 :
    Δ = Δ1 ∪ Δ2 -> Δ1 ##ₘ Δ2 ->
    rtv Δ1 v1 t1 -> rtv Δ2 v2 t2 ->
    rtv Δ (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
| rtv_Sum Δ n (ts : fin n -> type) (i : fin n) v :
    rtv Δ v (ts i) -> rtv Δ (SumV (fin_to_nat i) v) (SumT n ts)
| rtv_Barrier Δ n a b :
    Δ = {[ n := FunT Lin a b ]} ->
    rtv Δ (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin a b).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic environment and endpoint-context lemmas                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma env_unr_subset Γ Γ' : env_unr Γ' -> Γ ⊆ Γ' -> env_unr Γ.

Definition sc : relation A := λ x y, R x y ∨ R y x.

  (** The reflexive transitive closure. *)
  Inductive rtc : relation A :=
    | rtc_refl x : rtc x x
    | rtc_l x y z : R x y → rtc y z → rtc x z.

  (** The reflexive transitive closure for setoids. *)
  Inductive rtcS `{Equiv A} : relation A :=
    | rtcS_refl x y : x ≡ y → rtcS x y
    | rtcS_l x y z : R x y → rtcS y z → rtcS x z.

  (** Reductions of exactly [n] steps. *)
  Qed.
  Lemma rtc_ind_r (P : A → Prop) (x : A)
    (Prefl : P x) (Pstep : ∀ y z, rtc R x y → R y z → P y → P z) :
    ∀ z, rtc R x z → P z.
  Proof.
    intros z p. revert x z p Prefl Pstep. refine (rtc_ind_r_weak _ _ _); eauto.
  Qed.
  Lemma rtc_inv_r x z : rtc R x z → x = z ∨ ∃ y, rtc R x y ∧ R y z.
  Proof. revert z. apply rtc_ind_r; eauto. Qed.

  Lemma rtc_nf x y : rtc R x y → nf R x → x = y.

Lemma inv_step {ρ ρ' : cfg} : inv ρ -> step' ρ ρ' -> inv ρ'.
Proof.
  intros [ID [IOm [IS [IH1 [IH2 I]]]]] [i Hstep].
  destruct Hstep as [ρ0 ρ0' ρf i Hd Hd' Hls].
  exact (@inv_local_pure ρ0 ρ0' ρf i ID IOm IS IH1 IH2 I Hd Hd' Hls).
Qed.

Lemma inv_steps {ρ ρ' : cfg} : inv ρ -> steps ρ ρ' -> inv ρ'.
Proof.
  intros Hinv Hrt.
  revert Hinv.
  refine (rtc_ind_r (fun z => inv z) ρ _ _ ρ' Hrt).
  - intros. assumption.
  - intros y z Hrt' Hst Hy. apply inv_step; [exact Hy|].
    exact (ex_intro _ _ Hst).
Qed.

  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> global_progress ρ.
Proof.
  intros Ht Hsteps.
  apply global_progress_of_inv.
  exact (inv_steps (inv_initial e Ht) Hsteps).
